propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are present, allowing wholly-unconfigured Cloud environments to build a backend that fails only at first API call
Cloud adapter lacks construction-time credential presence and format validation that DC adapter implements via assert_env_ready and transport.py guards, creating a test-parity gap
test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly documents and pins the silent-build behavior that should instead fail loudly at construction
JIRA_USER must be validated as a valid email address (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) because Cloud authenticates using Atlassian account email, not bare handles
_build_jira_backend must raise BackendEnvError naming every missing credential variable and explaining the anonymous-access consequence before AcliClient construction
test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance uses invalid (non-email) JIRA_USER credentials that would bypass credential validation and must be updated to valid email format
